purpose: Define MeritCore temporal accounting using recurring one-week reporting intervals anchored to each identity's registration date, with hour-level atoms for sub-week work and no evidence multiplication by splitting.

topics.name: Merit Time Atom
topics.purpose: Define MeritCore temporal accounting using recurring one-week reporting intervals anchored to each identity's registration date, with hour-level atoms for sub-week work and no evidence multiplication by splitting.

semantics.week_rule: Primary reporting bucket is one week.
semantics.anchor_rule: Weekly cadence is anchored to the identity's registration date.
semantics.hour_rule: Sub-week work may be represented at hour-atom granularity inside the weekly bucket.
semantics.split_rule: Splitting a Project/work interval cannot multiply Tier evidence beyond the actual hour-level work represented.
semantics.distribution_rule: Evidence remains temporally distributed rather than collapsed into one lifetime aggregate.
semantics.time_rule: Each merit atom/bucket has explicit machine-readable interval semantics.
semantics.timezone_rule: Timezone/calendar interpretation is explicit where needed for deterministic boundaries.

invariants.rule: MeritCore-derived points, Tier, recommendations and trust remain bound to one identity and explicit Project/evidence history; they cannot be manufactured by presentation, identity merging or time-splitting.

hard_gates.condition: weekly cadence anchored to Project start instead of identity registration
sub-week work has no bounded atom semantics
all merit time collapsed into one undated total
deterministic bucket boundary cannot be reconstructed

prose.summary: Define MeritCore temporal accounting using recurring one-week reporting intervals anchored to each identity's registration date, with hour-level atoms for sub-week work and no evidence multiplication by splitting.
